name: referee_battery_penalty_rate_top_quartile
hypothesis: Home team's referee's prior-season mean total penalties/game (both teams combined) in the top quartile -- home cover rate vs. everyone else. Mechanism: more penalty stoppages per game are hypothesized to disrupt the road team's offensive rhythm/silent-count communication more than the home team's, producing a small home-cover edge under high-penalty-rate crews. Predeclared docs/referee_battery.md; recorded regardless of sign.

reliability_check.reason: referee-season mean total penalty rate is a persistent per-referee trait (measured year-over-year Pearson r = +0.370, 158 referee-season pairs); split-half is applicable.
